entry.title: Hello, world
entry.content:
Welcome to my site. This is where I’ll share research notes, short tutorials, and updates on what I’m working on in seismology — earthquake detection, relocation, and machine-learning phase picking.

Why a blog?

Writing things down forces clarity. I plan to use these notes to:

  • explain methods I find useful (and the gotchas I hit),
  • document small tools and workflows, and
  • keep a running log of project progress.

How to add a post

Create a file in _posts/ named YYYY-MM-DD-title.md with front matter like the top of this file, then write in Markdown. Math works too, via MathJax:

\[t_S - t_P \approx \frac{r}{v_P}\left(\frac{v_P}{v_S} - 1\right)\]

That’s it — thanks for reading.
